verdict.rationale:
Aider is itself an AI coding assistant to which users delegate tasks via natural language: chat mode, --message for one-shot instructions, /architect for planning+editing, /ask, /run, /test, and a scripting API (coder.run()) that programmatically delegates tasks, plus experimental autonomy ('navigator mode'). Community reports corroborate it functioning as an effective agentic assistant for real coding tasks, though with occasional quality/laziness complaints.

missing for 10: independent benchmark data on task completion rates beyond anecdotal community praise/complaints.
